meta.title: We Do Marketing — We Grow Together
meta.description: We Do Marketing is an A-Z marketing agency: social media, web design & SEO, online advertising and influence marketing. You focus on the business, we build the attention around it.

hero.title: We grow together.
hero.subtitle: You focus on the business. We build the attention around it.

intro.label: 01 — The starting point
intro.title: Good businesses still need to be seen.
intro.body: Your offer already has value. Marketing is the system that connects that value to the people looking for it. When attention starts moving, everything else follows.
intro.imgAlt: A lit path climbing a summit toward real results — the We Do Marketing ascent

about.label: 02 — Who we are
about.title: Marketing should move something.
about.body: We Do Marketing works with early-stage startups and large corporations alike — doctor offices, private hospitals, pharma, retailers, restaurants, e-commerce and government-affiliated organizations. One team, A to Z: strategy, web, search, social, video and consulting.
points: Every industry we touch, we learn
Strategy to execution, under one roof
about.imgAlt: The We Do Marketing studio — strategy, content, ads and growth on one desk

services.label: 03 — Services
services.title: One goal. More momentum.
services.intro: Four disciplines, one system. Each service feeds the others — attention compounds.
services.imgAlt: The We Do Marketing disciplines — social, ads, SEO, web, influence and consulting — connected as one ascending system

items.title: Social Media Management
items.desc: Accounts, content and campaigns built around your goals — managed closely with you, never at a distance.
items.imgAlt: Social media management — reach, content and growth metrics around a phone

items.title: Website Design / SEO
items.desc: Responsive websites for e-commerce, portfolios and blogs — designed to be found and built to convert.
items.imgAlt: Website design and SEO — a modern responsive site with search visibility

items.title: Online Advertising
items.desc: Data-driven campaigns across Google, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube — calibrated on your audience, your goals and your budget.
items.imgAlt: Online advertising — campaign performance across Google, Meta, TikTok and YouTube

items.title: Influence Marketing
items.desc: Collaborations with the voices your audience already follows — across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, podcasts and blogs.
items.imgAlt: Influence marketing — creators and campaign reach across social platforms

steps.title: Understand
steps.desc: Your business, your audience, your numbers. Strategy starts with listening.

steps.title: Create
steps.desc: Websites, content, campaigns — made to be remembered, not scrolled past.

steps.title: Amplify
steps.desc: Paid and organic channels carry the work where your audience actually lives.

steps.title: Grow
steps.desc: Measure, refine, repeat. Growth is a loop, not a launch.

works.label: 05 — Work
works.title: Ideas are easy to talk about. We prefer showing the work.

trust.label: 06 — Trust
trust.title: They trust us with the brands they built.
trust.body: Bakeries, clinics, contractors, e-commerce — organizations hand us their visibility. We take that personally.

contact.title: Have something worth growing?
contact.body: Tell us where you want to be. We'll draw the path.
